definitions.explanation: A Japanese cooking method where fish or other ingredients are seasoned simply with salt and then grilled. Also refers to food prepared this way. One of the most fundamental and traditional ways to cook fish in Japan, valued for bringing out the natural flavor of the ingredient.

⟦{今日|きょう}→今日：00496_kyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{夕飯|ゆうはん}→夕飯：02981_yuuhan⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{鮭|さけ}→鮭：19337_sake⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{塩焼|しおや}き⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦しよう→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Let's have salt-grilled salmon for dinner today.

notes:
USAGE:
{塩焼|しおや}き is one of the most common ways to cook fish in Japanese home cooking and restaurants. The dish is typically named as [fish] + ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ + {塩焼|しおや}き (e.g., さんま⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{塩焼|しおや}き). The simplicity of using only salt highlights the freshness and quality of the ingredient.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- さんま⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{塩焼|しおや}き: salt-grilled Pacific saury (autumn classic)
- ⟦{鮭|さけ}→鮭：19337_sake⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{塩焼|しおや}き: salt-grilled salmon
- ⟦{鯛|たい}→鯛：14709_tai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{塩焼|しおや}き: salt-grilled sea bream
- {塩焼|しおや}き⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to salt-grill (something)

CULTURAL NOTE:
Salt-grilled fish is a staple of the traditional Japanese breakfast and ⟦{定食|ていしょく}→定食：03123_teishoku⟧ (set meal). さんま⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{塩焼|しおや}き is particularly associated with autumn.
